resources.string: Stay focused. Let your messages wait.
Focus timer. Tap to change duration.
This batch is ready. New notifications go into the next batch.
Processing started. See Notifications for results and retries.
Pause only stops the timer. Notifications arriving during a break or analysis go into the next batch. Excluded notifications are not collected.
Your other apps keep their notification settings. Do Not Disturb and hidden content can affect what is visible or collected.
Set next default only (keep this timer)
Enter a whole number from 1 to 180.
Remaining time updated. Running or paused state is unchanged.
This timer has ended. Set the next default duration instead.
Next default set to %1$d minutes. This timer is unchanged.
Focusing · analysis starts when time is up
Next default: %1$d min · tap the timer to change
Exact alarms not allowed; background analysis may be delayed.
Start a focus timer or analyze now to see batches here.
Resend the existing summary without analyzing again. New filters do not change content already analyzed.
Analyze this batch again using current filters. New notifications remain in the next batch.
Recent notifications · exclusions hidden · up to 120
Matches a filter · original retained for review
Analyzed and completed batches retain originals. New filters cannot retract content already submitted.
Excluded content is hidden in batches that have not started analysis and will not be sent to AI.
Match only the exact body from %1$s, even when the title changes.\n\n%2$s
(Empty body: matches all notifications with an empty body from this app)
Match every notification from %1$s in channel “%2$s”, leaving other channels unchanged.
Applies now to new and unanalyzed records. Analysis already started or an existing reminder may still be sent. Remove the rule anytime in Notification filters.
Choose an AI service and reminder destination for summaries during your breaks.
Currently using %1$s. Save basic settings to switch providers.
Send notification content to the cloud?

Notifications may contain contacts, conversations, verification codes, or transaction details. Content goes to the selected AI endpoint; the summary appears on your device or in Feishu, as selected. Save settings after confirming.
Copy the Webhook from Feishu group settings → Group bots → Add custom bot. If your bot used 息间提醒 as a keyword, switch to signature verification and remove that keyword restriction.
A saved key could not be decrypted. Enter it again and save.
Keys, models, and endpoint URLs are saved separately for each provider.
Enter a valid Feishu bot Webhook URL.
Please confirm the cloud processing notice first.
%1$s basic settings saved. Advanced settings are unchanged.
Could not save the key. Cloud analysis is off.
Advanced settings save independently without switching the active AI or reminder destination. Signing is saved only for Feishu; filtering preferences are shared.
Signing secret (only if enabled for your bot)
Leave blank if bot signature verification is off. This is not your AI API key.
Extra filtering preferences (direct messages are kept)
Enter a valid full HTTPS endpoint URL.
Could not save advanced settings. Check the signing secret.
Editing %1$s · currently using %2$s. Save settings to switch.
A provider’s saved key could not be decrypted. Enter it again and save.
Pending, failed, and uncertain batches are retained. Completed or empty batches are kept for 30 days. Filters hide recent and unprocessed items; completed originals remain.
This cannot be undone. Settings, filters, and keys remain. Deletion is unavailable while analysis or sending is in progress.
Analysis or sending is in progress. Try again later.
Delete saved keys and turn off cloud analysis
Remove all three providers’ API keys, the Webhook, and the signing secret. Requests already sent cannot be retracted.
Tap “Stop collecting…” on a notification to exclude the same body, a channel, or an entire app.
Rules hide unanalyzed records; removing a rule restores collection. Batches already analyzed or with a generated reminder may still send. Historical originals remain.
No apps collected yet. Grant notification access first.
This excludes every notification from this app. To hide just one system message, choose a same-body rule on its notification card.
No filters yet. Use “Stop collecting…” on a notification to exclude one kind of message.
Filter removed. New notifications will be collected.
Complete the two steps below so StillBrief can keep collecting notifications in the background.
Not allowed; screen-off triggers may be delayed
Not reported on this Android version
Hiding only removes the task card; it does not improve background operation. Open the app from its home-screen icon afterward. Keep the card visible if you want to lock it in Recent apps.
This only hides the card, without improving background operation. Open StillBrief from its home-screen icon. Turn this off before locking the task card.
This shortcut is unavailable. Open StillBrief app details in system settings.
This phone blocks the shortcut. Open system settings manually.
The model returned blank content. Retry manually.
The model returned an invalid response format. Retry manually.
The model returned unknown, duplicate, or invalid notification IDs.
The model selection and summary are inconsistent or invalid.
The model summary is too long. Retry manually.
The model refused this batch or returned an unexpected action.
The model output was truncated or did not finish normally. Retry manually.
Enter the selected provider’s API key.
A valid HTTPS URL is required.
The service returned HTTP %1$d. Check settings, then retry manually.
The network request failed or timed out. Retry manually.
The service response was too large. Retry manually.
The Feishu Webhook URL is invalid.
Feishu rejected the request. Check the signature, keywords, and bot settings.
Enable AI analysis and reminders in Settings.
Analysis failed. Check the response format, configuration, or keys, then retry manually.
Sending settings are invalid or reminders are off. Check settings, then retry manually.
Delivery is uncertain. Check Feishu first; retrying may create a duplicate.
Settings → Apps → App launch → %1$s. Turn off automatic management and enable auto-launch, secondary launch, and background activity.\nYou can also search system settings for App launch.
In app details, allow auto-start and background activity for %1$s where those options are available. You can also search system settings for Auto-start or App launch.
Check auto-start manually in your phone’s system settings.
Battery optimization is off for this app
Battery optimization still applies to this app
Choose Allow in the system request. Alternatively, select Unrestricted or Not optimized in this app’s battery settings.

On HONOR/HUAWEI, if Battery optimization offers Allow / Don’t allow, choose Don’t allow: this prevents the system from optimizing this app. Search settings for Battery optimization and select All apps to find it.
Allow this app to ignore battery optimization
Battery settings could not be opened. Search system settings for Battery optimization and find this app.
Phone-wide Battery Saver is separate from this app’s optimization exemption. Turn it off before checking background collection.
Open Recent apps, pull down the %1$s card or use its menu to lock it. Check this setting manually.
Your task card is hidden. First turn off Hide from Recent apps at the bottom of Settings, then lock the card.
Current destination: %1$s. Save settings to switch.
Editing %1$s; currently using %2$s. Save to apply.
Enter the selected AI provider’s API key.
Local notifications and Do Not Disturb
AI-filtered notification summaries for your breaks
A summary is ready. Unlock to view it.
This is a local test reminder. Check sound, banners, and Do Not Disturb settings.
Notification permission has not been granted. Open local notification settings to allow it.
Notifications for this app are off. Enable them in system notification settings.
The notification summary channel is blocked. Enable it in channel settings.
Test notification posted. Check your notification shade.

To allow reminders during Do Not Disturb: Do Not Disturb → Allowed interruptions → Apps → add %1$s. You can also check the summary channel for an Allow interruptions option and choose it in system settings.
This shortcut is unavailable. Search system settings for Do Not Disturb.
This batch no longer exists or has been cleared.
%1$s may already have received the last summary. Retrying could create a duplicate.
This retry will use %1$s instead of %2$s.
This retry keeps this batch’s destination: %1$s.
Enable local notifications and the summary channel, then retry manually.
The local reminder could not be posted. Check notification settings and retry.
Posting the local reminder was interrupted. Retry manually; the same batch updates its original notification.
Focus duration. Adjust the dial or tap to enter exact minutes
